# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-27: identify the features that matter most for the `r params$set_word`, overall
and per SHAP cluster, and which features matter more in one cluster than another.
`26b_target_subtypes_features.Rmd` clusters the targets; this notebook only reads its result.

- **SHAP is reused, not recomputed.** Each gene's SHAP comes from `23_shap_gene_clustering.Rmd`'s
  out-of-fold run of the intrinsic regression forest (predicting TE change, log2(sictrl / si3d),
  on all modelled genes); each gene is explained by a forest that never trained on it.
- **Clusters** are `26b_`'s `r params$profile` k = `r params$k` clustering, re-derived here and
  asserted equal to its saved CSV.

**Terms used below.**

- **Share**: a feature's |SHAP| divided by the gene's total |SHAP| over all features, averaged
  over a group of genes. "What fraction of the model's explanation of these genes goes through
  this feature." This is the scale the clustering used.
- **Absolute**: mean |SHAP| in TE-change units. Shares are zero-sum within a gene - if one family
  dominates a cluster, every other feature's share there shrinks - so a difference in share alone
  can come from *other* features. A difference present on both scales is a real one.
- **Family**: SHAP is additive, so a family's SHAP is the exact sum of its members' signed SHAP.
  Correlated features (the GC columns, the length columns) split credit; the family level does not.
- **Direction**: Spearman rho between a feature's value and its own SHAP within the targets.
  Positive = a higher value pushes predicted TE change up (more eIF3d-dependent).
- **Held-out labels (cross-fitting)**: the targets are split into `r params$n_fold` folds; for each
  fold, k-means is fitted on the other folds, its centres are matched to the reported clusters,
  and the fold's genes are assigned to the nearest centre. Every gene gets a label it did not help
  define. Repeated `r params$n_rep` times with different splits.
- **Sign consistency**: in each repeat, the difference is recomputed on a bootstrap resample of
  genes under that repeat's held-out labels. The count of repeats (of `r params$n_rep`) whose sign
  matches the original difference. It is graded, not a filter; the random-label control in
  section 3 says what count pure noise reaches.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here); library(patchwork) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
K <- as.integer(params$k)
ptag <- sub("_lfc.*$", "", sub("^eif33d_promotes_", "", params$suffix))
lab_set <- paste(params$label, params$set_word)
div <- c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00")
```

# 1. Targets, SHAP and clusters

```{r load}
oof <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix, ".rds")))
fc <- colnames(oof$S)
ann <- read_csv(file.path(O, "feature_annotation.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
fam <- setNames(ann$family[match(fc, ann$feature)], fc)
stopifnot("a feature has no family" = !anyNA(fam),
          "SHAP rows and genes out of step" = identical(rownames(oof$S), oof$genes$gene_id_clean))
fam_cols <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2",
                                        "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "grey50"))(n_distinct(fam)), sort(unique(fam)))
rows <- fc[order(fam, fc)]                 # same row order as 26b_'s heatmaps
fams <- sort(unique(fam))

norm_rows <- function(M) M / pmax(rowSums(abs(M)), 1e-12)
tg <- oof$genes$set == params$set_label
genes <- oof$genes[tg, ]
S <- oof$S[tg, , drop = FALSE]
Sn <- norm_rows(S)
# family SHAP = exact sum of members' signed SHAP
famsum <- function(M) sapply(fams, function(f) rowSums(M[, fam == f, drop = FALSE]))
Sf <- famsum(S); Sfn <- norm_rows(Sf)
stopifnot("normalized rows do not sum to 1" = all(abs(rowSums(abs(Sn)) - 1) < 1e-9),
          "family sums do not reproduce the gene total" = max(abs(rowSums(Sf) - rowSums(S))) < 1e-9)

# Re-derive 26b_'s clustering exactly as it does it, then assert against its saved CSV
stopifnot("only the normalized profile is clustered on Sn here" = params$profile == "features, normalized")
set.seed(9); km <- kmeans(Sn, centers = K, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)
relab <- match(seq_len(K), as.integer(names(sort(table(km$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))))
cl <- relab[km$cluster]                                       # largest = 1, as in 26b_
C_ref <- km$centers[order(relab), , drop = FALSE]             # row j = centre of cluster j
saved <- read_csv(file.path(O, paste0("target_shap_feature_clusters_", params$suffix, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(profile == params$profile, k == K)
stopifnot("saved clustering missing - knit 26b_ first" = nrow(saved) == nrow(genes),
          "clusters differ from 26b_'s saved CSV" =
            identical(as.integer(saved$cluster[match(genes$gene_id_clean, saved$gene_id_clean)]), as.integer(cl)),
          "relabelled centres do not reproduce the clusters" =
            identical(max.col(-sapply(seq_len(K), function(j) rowSums(sweep(Sn, 2, C_ref[j, ])^2))), as.integer(cl)))
n_cl <- table(cl)
cat(sprintf("%d targets of %d modelled genes | %d features in %d families | cluster sizes %s\n",
            nrow(genes), nrow(oof$genes), length(fc), length(fams), paste(n_cl, collapse = " / ")))

# Feature values for direction, unimputed, as in 26b_
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean),
          "targets missing from the matrix" = !anyNA(match(genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean)))
X <- fm[match(genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean), fc] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x)))) %>% as.matrix()
```

# 2. Overall: the most important features for the targets

Ranked by share within the targets. The interval is the 5-95% range over `r params$n_boot`
bootstrap resamples of the targets, for both the share and the rank. Non-target share is the same
quantity over every other modelled gene, so `target - non-target` says which features carry more
of the explanation for targets than for a typical gene.

```{r overall}
dir_rho <- function(Xm, Sm) sapply(colnames(Sm), function(f) {
  x <- Xm[, f]; if (sum(!is.na(x)) < 10 || sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) NA_real_ else
    suppressWarnings(cor(x, Sm[, f], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")) })
Snt <- norm_rows(oof$S[!tg, , drop = FALSE]); Sfnt <- norm_rows(famsum(oof$S[!tg, , drop = FALSE]))

set.seed(9); boots <- replicate(params$n_boot, sample(nrow(genes), replace = TRUE), simplify = FALSE)
summ_level <- function(An, A, Ant, Xm, Sm, ids) {
  sh <- colMeans(abs(An))
  bs <- sapply(boots, function(i) colMeans(abs(An[i, , drop = FALSE])))
  br <- apply(bs, 2, function(v) rank(-v))
  rho <- if (is.null(Xm)) NULL else dir_rho(Xm, Sm)
  brho <- if (is.null(Xm)) NULL else sapply(boots[seq_len(min(50, length(boots)))], function(i) dir_rho(Xm[i, , drop = FALSE], Sm[i, , drop = FALSE]))
  tibble(name = ids, share = sh, share_lo = apply(bs, 1, quantile, 0.05), share_hi = apply(bs, 1, quantile, 0.95),
         rank = rank(-sh), rank_lo = apply(br, 1, quantile, 0.05), rank_hi = apply(br, 1, quantile, 0.95),
         absolute = colMeans(abs(A)), share_nontargets = colMeans(abs(Ant)),
         target_minus_nontarget = sh - colMeans(abs(Ant)),
         direction_rho = if (is.null(rho)) NA_real_ else rho,
         direction_sign_kept = if (is.null(rho)) NA_real_ else rowMeans(sign(brho) == sign(rho), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(rank)
}
ov_feat <- summ_level(Sn, S, Snt, X, S, fc) %>% mutate(family = fam[name], .after = name)
ov_fam <- summ_level(Sfn, Sf, Sfnt, NULL, NULL, fams) %>% mutate(family = name, .after = name)
stopifnot("feature shares do not sum to 1" = abs(sum(ov_feat$share) - 1) < 1e-9,
          "family shares do not sum to 1" = abs(sum(ov_fam$share) - 1) < 1e-9,
          "direction outside [-1, 1]" = all(abs(ov_feat$direction_rho) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE))
ov_feat <- ov_feat %>% mutate(direction = case_when(is.na(direction_rho) ~ "n/a",
                                                    direction_sign_kept < 0.9 ~ "unclear",
                                                    direction_rho > 0 ~ "higher value -> higher TE change",
                                                    TRUE ~ "higher value -> lower TE change"))
cat("Families:\n")
knitr::kable(ov_fam %>% dplyr::select(family, share, share_lo, share_hi, rank, rank_lo, rank_hi, share_nontargets, target_minus_nontarget) %>%
               mutate(across(starts_with("share") | target_minus_nontarget, ~ 100 * .x)), digits = 1,
             caption = "family share of the explanation, % (targets vs non-targets)")
knitr::kable(ov_feat %>% head(20) %>% dplyr::select(name, family, share, share_lo, share_hi, rank, rank_lo, rank_hi,
                                                     target_minus_nontarget, direction_rho, direction) %>%
               mutate(across(c(share, share_lo, share_hi, target_minus_nontarget), ~ 100 * .x)), digits = c(0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 0),
             caption = "top 20 features by share, % (direction 'unclear' = sign kept in < 90% of 50 bootstraps)")
```

```{r fig_overall, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 10}
p_ov <- function(d, title, ylab_txt) {
  d <- d %>% mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, share))
  ggplot(d, aes(y = name)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = 100 * share_lo, xmax = 100 * share_hi), height = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(aes(x = 100 * share_nontargets), shape = 1, colour = "grey50", size = 1.8) +
    geom_point(aes(x = 100 * share, colour = family), size = 2.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fam_cols) +
    labs(x = "share of the explanation (%)", y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = if (nrow(d) > 20) 7 else 10))
}
p_all <- (p_ov(ov_feat, "features", "") + theme(legend.position = "none")) + p_ov(ov_fam, "families", "") +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.8)) +
  plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: what the model's explanation of the targets goes through", lab_set),
                  subtitle = sprintf("filled = targets (n = %s), bar = 5-95%% over %d bootstraps; open grey = all other modelled genes (n = %s)\nshare = |SHAP| / gene's total |SHAP|, averaged over genes; family = exact sum of members' SHAP",
                                     scales::comma(nrow(genes)), params$n_boot, scales::comma(sum(!tg))))
p_all
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_feature_importance_overall_", ptag, ".pdf")), p_all, width = 13, height = 10)
```

# 3. Per cluster: which features matter more in one cluster than another

Each comparison is a difference in group means: a cluster vs the other targets, and every pair of
clusters. Positive = matters more in the first-named group. Shown on both scales; the
held-out interval and sign consistency come from the cross-fitted labels with gene resampling
(section 1 terms).

```{r crossfit}
perms <- function(v) if (length(v) <= 1) list(v) else
  do.call(c, lapply(seq_along(v), function(i) lapply(perms(v[-i]), function(p) c(v[i], p))))
P <- perms(seq_len(K))
nearest <- function(M, C) max.col(-sapply(seq_len(nrow(C)), function(j) rowSums(sweep(M, 2, C[j, ])^2)), ties.method = "first")
set.seed(9)
cf <- lapply(seq_len(params$n_rep), function(r) {
  fold <- sample(rep_len(seq_len(params$n_fold), nrow(Sn)))
  lab <- integer(nrow(Sn))
  for (f in seq_len(params$n_fold)) {
    kmf <- kmeans(Sn[fold != f, , drop = FALSE], centers = K, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)
    # match the fold's centres to the reported ones (exhaustive over K! orderings)
    cost <- sapply(P, function(p) sum((kmf$centers[p, , drop = FALSE] - C_ref)^2))
    Cm <- kmf$centers[P[[which.min(cost)]], , drop = FALSE]    # row j now = reported cluster j
    lab[fold == f] <- nearest(Sn[fold == f, , drop = FALSE], Cm)
  }
  list(lab = lab, boot = sample(nrow(Sn), replace = TRUE))
})
agree <- map_dbl(cf, ~ mean(.x$lab == cl))
stopifnot("every gene needs a held-out label" = all(map_lgl(cf, ~ all(.x$lab %in% seq_len(K)))),
          # a broken centre matching scrambles labels and agreement collapses towards 1/K
          "held-out labels barely agree with the clusters - centre matching failed" = median(agree) > 0.6)
cat(sprintf("held-out label agreement with the reported clusters: median %.3f, range %.3f-%.3f over %d repeats\n",
            median(agree), min(agree), max(agree), params$n_rep))

comps <- c(setNames(as.list(seq_len(K)), sprintf("cluster %d vs rest", seq_len(K))),
           { pr <- combn(K, 2, simplify = FALSE); setNames(pr, map_chr(pr, ~ sprintf("cluster %d vs %d", .x[1], .x[2]))) })
diff_mat <- function(A, lab) sapply(comps, function(cp) {
  if (length(cp) == 1) colMeans(A[lab == cp, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(A[lab != cp, , drop = FALSE])
  else colMeans(A[lab == cp[1], , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(A[lab == cp[2], , drop = FALSE]) })
scales_list <- list(feature = list(share = abs(Sn), absolute = abs(S)), family = list(share = abs(Sfn), absolute = abs(Sf)))

run_diffs <- function(A, lab_fun) {
  D0 <- diff_mat(A, cl)
  Dr <- lapply(seq_along(cf), function(r) { i <- cf[[r]]$boot; diff_mat(A[i, , drop = FALSE], lab_fun(r)[i]) })
  arr <- simplify2array(Dr)
  list(D0 = D0, med = apply(arr, 1:2, median), lo = apply(arr, 1:2, quantile, 0.05), hi = apply(arr, 1:2, quantile, 0.95),
       kept = apply(sweep(sign(arr), 1:2, sign(D0), "=="), 1:2, sum))
}
long_of <- function(res, level, scale) {
  tl <- function(M, v) as_tibble(M, rownames = "name") %>% pivot_longer(-name, names_to = "comparison", values_to = v)
  reduce(list(tl(res$D0, "diff"), tl(res$med, "diff_heldout"), tl(res$lo, "diff_lo"), tl(res$hi, "diff_hi"), tl(res$kept, "sign_kept")),
         left_join, by = c("name", "comparison")) %>% mutate(level = level, scale = scale, .before = 1)
}
cd <- imap_dfr(scales_list, function(sl, lev) imap_dfr(sl, ~ long_of(run_diffs(.x, function(r) cf[[r]]$lab), lev, .y)))

# Random-label control: same procedure, but each repeat's labels are a size-preserving shuffle.
# It says what sign consistency a difference with no cluster information behind it reaches.
set.seed(9); shuf <- lapply(seq_len(params$n_rep), function(r) sample(cl))
ctrl <- run_diffs(abs(Sn), function(r) shuf[[r]])$kept
thr <- as.integer(ceiling(quantile(ctrl, 0.95)))
stopifnot("random labels look informative - check the control" = median(ctrl) <= 0.7 * params$n_rep)
cat(sprintf("random-label control (feature shares): sign kept median %d, 95th percentile %d of %d -> 'stable' = kept in >= %d\n",
            as.integer(median(ctrl)), thr, params$n_rep, min(thr + 1L, params$n_rep)))
thr_stable <- min(thr + 1L, params$n_rep)
cd <- cd %>% mutate(family = if_else(level == "feature", fam[name], name), .after = name,
                    stable = sign_kept >= thr_stable,
                    both_scales = NA)
# a difference counts on both scales when it is stable with the same sign on share and absolute
both <- cd %>% dplyr::select(level, name, comparison, scale, diff, stable) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = scale, values_from = c(diff, stable)) %>%
  transmute(level, name, comparison, both_scales = stable_share & stable_absolute & sign(diff_share) == sign(diff_absolute))
cd <- cd %>% dplyr::select(-both_scales) %>% left_join(both, by = c("level", "name", "comparison"))
stopifnot("every feature x comparison x scale present" =
            nrow(cd) == 2 * length(comps) * (length(fc) + length(fams)))
```

```{r cluster_tables}
grp_share <- sapply(seq_len(K), function(g) colMeans(abs(Sn[cl == g, , drop = FALSE])))
colnames(grp_share) <- paste("cluster", seq_len(K))
fmt <- function(d) d %>% mutate(diff_pp = 100 * diff, heldout_pp = 100 * diff_heldout,
                                interval = sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", 100 * diff_lo, 100 * diff_hi))
for (g in seq_len(K)) {
  cmp <- sprintf("cluster %d vs rest", g)
  d <- cd %>% filter(level == "feature", scale == "share", comparison == cmp) %>% fmt() %>%
    mutate(share_in_cluster = 100 * grp_share[name, g]) %>% arrange(desc(diff))
  print(knitr::kable(bind_rows(head(d, 8), tail(d, 5)) %>%
                       dplyr::select(name, family, share_in_cluster, diff_pp, heldout_pp, interval, sign_kept, both_scales),
                     digits = 2, caption = sprintf("%s (n = %d): most over- and under-used features, share difference in percentage points", cmp, n_cl[g])))
}
knitr::kable(cd %>% filter(level == "family", scale == "share") %>% fmt() %>%
               dplyr::select(comparison, name, diff_pp, interval, sign_kept, both_scales) %>%
               pivot_wider(id_cols = name, names_from = comparison, values_from = diff_pp), digits = 1,
             caption = "family share differences, percentage points (stability in the CSV)")
```

```{r fig_dot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 11}
dot <- bind_rows(tibble(name = fc, group = "all targets", share = colMeans(abs(Sn)), diff = NA_real_, stable = FALSE),
                 map_dfr(seq_len(K), function(g) cd %>% filter(level == "feature", scale == "share", comparison == sprintf("cluster %d vs rest", g)) %>%
                           transmute(name, group = sprintf("cluster %d", g), share = grp_share[name, g], diff, stable = both_scales))) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("all targets", paste("cluster", seq_len(K)))),
         name = factor(name, levels = rev(rows)))
lab_n <- setNames(c(sprintf("all targets\n(n = %s)", scales::comma(nrow(genes))), sprintf("cluster %d\n(n = %d)", seq_len(K), n_cl)),
                  levels(dot$group))
dcap <- max(abs(dot$diff), na.rm = TRUE)
fam_strip <- tibble(name = factor(rows, levels = rev(rows)), family = fam[rows])
p_strip <- ggplot(fam_strip, aes(x = 1, y = name, fill = family)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_manual(values = fam_cols) +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "left")
p_dot <- ggplot(dot, aes(group, name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = 100 * share, fill = 100 * diff, stroke = if_else(stable, 0.9, 0.2)), shape = 21, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div[1], mid = div[2], high = div[3], limits = c(-100 * dcap, 100 * dcap), na.value = "grey80",
                       name = "cluster vs other\ntargets (pp)") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, name = "share (%)") + scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_n) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
p_dotc <- (p_strip + p_dot + plot_layout(widths = c(0.04, 1))) +
  plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: feature share per cluster (normalized SHAP, k = %d)", lab_set, K),
                  subtitle = sprintf("size = share of the explanation; color = cluster minus the other targets\nthick outline = stable on both share and absolute scales (sign kept in >= %d of %d held-out repeats)",
                                     thr_stable, params$n_rep))
p_dotc
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_feature_share_by_cluster_", ptag, "_k", K, ".pdf")), p_dotc, width = 9, height = 11)
```

```{r fig_pairwise, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 11, results = "asis"}
tile_plot <- function(d, sc, ord, unit_mult, unit_lab, fmt_txt) {
  d <- d %>% filter(scale == sc) %>% mutate(name = factor(name, levels = rev(ord)), comparison = factor(comparison, levels = names(comps)),
                                            v = unit_mult * diff)
  cap <- max(abs(d$v))
  ggplot(d, aes(comparison, name)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = v, alpha = stable), colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf(fmt_txt, v)), size = if (length(ord) > 20) 1.9 else 3, colour = "grey15") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = div[1], mid = div[2], high = div[3], limits = c(-cap, cap), name = unit_lab) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.3), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sc) + theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(size = if (length(ord) > 20) 6.5 else 10))
}
for (lev in c("feature", "family")) {
  d <- cd %>% filter(level == lev); ord <- if (lev == "feature") rows else fams
  p <- tile_plot(d, "share", ord, 100, "difference\n(pp of share)", "%.1f") +
    tile_plot(d, "absolute", ord, 1000, "difference\n(mean |SHAP| x 1000)", "%.1f") +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: which %s matter more in one cluster than another (k = %d)", lab_set,
                                  if (lev == "feature") "features" else "families", K),
                    subtitle = sprintf("positive (orange) = more in the first-named group; faded = sign kept in < %d of %d held-out repeats\ncluster sizes %s; share = fraction of each gene's |SHAP|, absolute = mean |SHAP| in TE LFC units",
                                       thr_stable, params$n_rep, paste(sprintf("%d: n = %d", seq_len(K), n_cl), collapse = ", ")))
  cat("\n\n## ", lev, "s\n\n", sep = ""); print(p)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_", lev, "_cluster_differences_", ptag, "_k", K, ".pdf")), p,
                   width = 14, height = if (lev == "feature") 11 else 5.5)
}
```

# 4. Feature values per gene for the top SHAP features

`26b_`'s per-gene feature-value heatmap (section 6b), cut down to the `r params$n_top` features
with the largest overall share in section 2, in rank order (most important at the top). Drawn
twice: genes grouped by the **normalized** SHAP clusters and by the **raw** SHAP clusters (raw =
SHAP not divided by the gene's total, so clusters also reflect how strongly a gene was called),
both at k = `r params$k`. The same 12 rows in both, so the two groupings can be compared.
Values are z-scores against all modelled genes, (gene value - all-gene mean) / all-gene sd,
unimputed and capped at +/-2.5; grey = missing.

```{r top_value_heatmaps, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5.5, results = "asis"}
top <- ov_feat$name[seq_len(params$n_top)]
Xall <- fm[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean), top] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x)))) %>% as.matrix()
mu_all <- colMeans(Xall, na.rm = TRUE); sd_all <- apply(Xall, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot("a top feature has no variance" = all(sd_all > 0))
Ztg <- sweep(sweep(Xall[tg, , drop = FALSE], 2, mu_all), 2, sd_all, "/")
stopifnot("target rows out of step" = identical(oof$genes$gene_id_clean[tg], genes$gene_id_clean))
saved_all <- read_csv(file.path(O, paste0("target_shap_feature_clusters_", params$suffix, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
# cross-check: per-cluster means of these z-scores must reproduce 26b_'s saved mean panel
zsaved <- read_csv(file.path(O, paste0("target_feature_cor_and_mean_", params$suffix, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
zs <- as.matrix(zsaved[match(top, zsaved$feature), paste0("z_cluster ", seq_len(K))])
stopifnot("26b_'s saved means are for a different clustering - knit 26b_ with report_profile = features, normalized" =
            max(abs(sapply(seq_len(K), function(g) colMeans(Ztg[cl == g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)) - zs)) < 1e-9)
sym <- function(x, cap = 1.5) { x <- pmin(pmax(x, -cap), cap); x[c(which.min(x), which.max(x))] <- c(-cap, cap); x }
cl_cols <- c("#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#D55E00", "#56B4E9", "grey40", "#882255")
lfc_label <- "LFC sictrl/si3d (cap 1.5)"
zc <- 2.5
# Each feature's direction (section 2): sign of rho(value, own SHAP) within the targets, as a row
# annotation so a colour can be read as helping or hurting (Kate, 2026-10-27)
dir_lab <- setNames(ov_feat$direction[match(top, ov_feat$name)], top)
dir_cols <- c("higher value -> higher TE change" = "#D55E00", "higher value -> lower TE change" = "#0072B2",
              "unclear" = "grey70", "n/a" = "white")
row_ann <- function(rl) data.frame(direction = dir_lab[rl], family = fam[rl], row.names = rl)
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  clp <- as.integer(a$cluster[match(genes$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)])
  stopifnot("clustering missing from 26b_'s CSV" = nrow(a) == nrow(genes), !anyNA(clp))
  if (pr == params$profile) stopifnot("normalized clusters differ from section 1" = identical(clp, as.integer(cl)))
  ord <- order(clp, -genes$y)
  H <- t(Ztg[ord, , drop = FALSE]); colnames(H) <- genes$gene_id_clean[ord]
  H <- pmin(pmax(H, -zc), zc)
  rownames(H) <- top
  acol <- data.frame(cluster = factor(clp[ord]), lfc = sym(genes$y[ord]), check.names = FALSE, row.names = colnames(H))
  names(acol)[2] <- lfc_label
  acols <- list(cluster = setNames(cl_cols[seq_len(K)], seq_len(K)), lfc_tmp = colorRampPalette(div)(51), family = fam_cols[sort(unique(fam[top]))])
  names(acols)[names(acols) == "lfc_tmp"] <- lfc_label
  acols$direction <- dir_cols[unique(dir_lab)]
  # Two row layouts: rank order, and grouped by family (families in order of their best-ranked
  # member, rank order within a family, a gap between families)
  fam_ord <- unique(fam[top])
  layouts <- list(rank = top, family = top[order(match(fam[top], fam_ord), seq_along(top))])
  for (lay in names(layouts)) {
    rl <- layouts[[lay]]
    gaps_r <- if (lay == "family") head(cumsum(table(factor(fam[rl], levels = fam_ord))), -1) else NULL
    hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(H[rl, , drop = FALSE], cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
                   color = colorRampPalette(div)(101), breaks = seq(-zc, zc, length.out = 102), na_col = "grey85",
                   annotation_col = acol, annotation_row = row_ann(rl),
                   annotation_colors = acols, gaps_col = cumsum(table(clp))[-K], gaps_row = gaps_r, fontsize_row = 9,
                   main = sprintf("%s (n = %d genes; cluster sizes %s)\ntop %d SHAP features (by share), %s | genes grouped by %s SHAP clusters, k = %d\ncolor = z-score vs all modelled genes (n = %s; orange higher, blue lower, capped at +/-2.5); grey = missing",
                                  lab_set, nrow(genes), paste(table(clp), collapse = "/"), params$n_top,
                                  if (lay == "family") "rows grouped by family" else "rows in rank order",
                                  sub("features, ", "", pr), K, scales::comma(nrow(oof$genes))), fontsize = 9, silent = TRUE)
    cat("\n\n## ", pr, ", rows by ", lay, "\n\n", sep = ""); grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
    if (SAVE) {
      pdf(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_top", params$n_top, "_feature_values_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K,
                               if (lay == "family") "_by_family" else "", ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 5.5)
      grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```

The same feature values, **aligned to direction** (Kate, 2026-10-27): each feature's z-score is
multiplied by the sign of its direction rho (section 2), so for every row orange means the gene's
value sits on the side that pushes predicted TE change up (towards more eIF3d-dependent) and blue
the side that pushes it down. Rows whose sign was flipped (higher value -> lower TE change, e.g.
CDS GC) are marked "(flipped)": there, orange = a *low* value. Colour is still the feature value,
not SHAP, so a cell can be orange while the forest gave that gene little credit for the feature.

```{r top_aligned_heatmaps, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5.5, results = "asis"}
sgn <- sign(ov_feat$direction_rho[match(top, ov_feat$name)]); names(sgn) <- top
stopifnot("a top feature has no direction" = !anyNA(sgn), all(sgn != 0))
cat(sprintf("\n\nflipped (higher value -> lower TE change): %s\n", paste(top[sgn < 0], collapse = ", ")))
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  clp <- as.integer(a$cluster[match(genes$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)])
  ord <- order(clp, -genes$y)
  H <- t(sweep(Ztg[ord, , drop = FALSE], 2, sgn, "*")); colnames(H) <- genes$gene_id_clean[ord]
  H <- pmin(pmax(H, -zc), zc)
  acol <- data.frame(cluster = factor(clp[ord]), lfc = sym(genes$y[ord]), check.names = FALSE, row.names = colnames(H))
  names(acol)[2] <- lfc_label
  acols <- list(cluster = setNames(cl_cols[seq_len(K)], seq_len(K)), lfc_tmp = colorRampPalette(div)(51), family = fam_cols[sort(unique(fam[top]))])
  names(acols)[names(acols) == "lfc_tmp"] <- lfc_label
  acols$direction <- dir_cols[unique(dir_lab)]
  fam_ord <- unique(fam[top])
  layouts <- list(rank = top, family = top[order(match(fam[top], fam_ord), seq_along(top))])
  for (lay in names(layouts)) {
    rl <- layouts[[lay]]
    gaps_r <- if (lay == "family") head(cumsum(table(factor(fam[rl], levels = fam_ord))), -1) else NULL
    hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(H[rl, , drop = FALSE], cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
                   color = colorRampPalette(div)(101), breaks = seq(-zc, zc, length.out = 102), na_col = "grey85",
                   annotation_col = acol, annotation_row = row_ann(rl),
                   labels_row = ifelse(sgn[rl] < 0, paste0(rl, " (flipped)"), rl),
                   annotation_colors = acols, gaps_col = cumsum(table(clp))[-K], gaps_row = gaps_r, fontsize_row = 9,
                   main = sprintf("%s (n = %d genes; cluster sizes %s)\ntop %d SHAP features (by share), %s | genes grouped by %s SHAP clusters, k = %d\ncolor = z-score x direction sign (orange = value on the side that raises predicted TE change, blue = lowers; cap +/-2.5)",
                                  lab_set, nrow(genes), paste(table(clp), collapse = "/"), params$n_top,
                                  if (lay == "family") "rows grouped by family" else "rows in rank order",
                                  sub("features, ", "", pr), K), fontsize = 9, silent = TRUE)
    cat("\n\n## Direction-aligned values, ", pr, ", rows by ", lay, "\n\n", sep = ""); grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
    if (SAVE) {
      pdf(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_top", params$n_top, "_feature_values_aligned_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K,
                               if (lay == "family") "_by_family" else "", ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 5.5)
      grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```

The same heatmaps coloured by each gene's **signed SHAP** instead of its feature value (Kate,
2026-10-27). SHAP has direction: orange means that feature pushed the gene's predicted TE change
(log2(sictrl / si3d)) **up**, towards more eIF3d-dependent; blue means it pushed it down. Each
clustering is shown in the units it was clustered on: the raw clustering in raw SHAP (log2 TE
change units), the normalized clustering in signed share (SHAP / the gene's total |SHAP|, so a
row's absolute values sum to 1 across all 57 features). The colour cap is the 99th percentile of
|SHAP| over these 12 features in the targets. Genes, clusters and row order match the value
heatmaps above, so the two can be read side by side.

```{r top_shap_heatmaps, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5.5, results = "asis"}
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  clp <- as.integer(a$cluster[match(genes$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)])
  ord <- order(clp, -genes$y)
  M <- if (pr == "features, raw") S else Sn
  cap <- signif(quantile(abs(M[, top]), 0.99), 2)
  H <- t(M[ord, top, drop = FALSE]); colnames(H) <- genes$gene_id_clean[ord]
  H <- pmin(pmax(H, -cap), cap)
  acol <- data.frame(cluster = factor(clp[ord]), lfc = sym(genes$y[ord]), check.names = FALSE, row.names = colnames(H))
  names(acol)[2] <- lfc_label
  acols <- list(cluster = setNames(cl_cols[seq_len(K)], seq_len(K)), lfc_tmp = colorRampPalette(div)(51), family = fam_cols[sort(unique(fam[top]))])
  names(acols)[names(acols) == "lfc_tmp"] <- lfc_label
  fam_ord <- unique(fam[top])
  layouts <- list(rank = top, family = top[order(match(fam[top], fam_ord), seq_along(top))])
  unit_txt <- if (pr == "features, raw") "raw SHAP, log2 TE change units" else "signed SHAP / gene total |SHAP|"
  cat(sprintf("\n\n%s: %s, capped at +/-%s; %.0f%% of the 12 x %d cells are positive\n",
              pr, unit_txt, cap, 100 * mean(M[, top] > 0), nrow(genes)))
  for (lay in names(layouts)) {
    rl <- layouts[[lay]]
    gaps_r <- if (lay == "family") head(cumsum(table(factor(fam[rl], levels = fam_ord))), -1) else NULL
    hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(H[rl, , drop = FALSE], cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
                   color = colorRampPalette(div)(101), breaks = seq(-cap, cap, length.out = 102),
                   annotation_col = acol, annotation_row = data.frame(family = fam[rl], row.names = rl),
                   annotation_colors = acols, gaps_col = cumsum(table(clp))[-K], gaps_row = gaps_r, fontsize_row = 9,
                   main = sprintf("%s (n = %d genes; cluster sizes %s)\ntop %d SHAP features (by share), %s | genes grouped by %s SHAP clusters, k = %d\ncolor = %s (orange pushes predicted TE change up, blue down; cap +/-%s)",
                                  lab_set, nrow(genes), paste(table(clp), collapse = "/"), params$n_top,
                                  if (lay == "family") "rows grouped by family" else "rows in rank order",
                                  sub("features, ", "", pr), K, unit_txt, cap), fontsize = 9, silent = TRUE)
    cat("\n\n## Signed SHAP, ", pr, ", rows by ", lay, "\n\n", sep = ""); grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
    if (SAVE) {
      pdf(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_top", params$n_top, "_signed_shap_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K,
                               if (lay == "family") "_by_family" else "", ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 5.5)
      grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```

The matching correlation panels: `26b_`'s section 6 correlation panel for the same 12 features,
in the same order, once per clustering. Each cell is the Spearman rho between the feature's value
and TE change (log2(sictrl / si3d)). The first column is every modelled gene; the rest are within
the targets, where TE change is already truncated at > 0.5, so those correlations are weaker by
construction and ask which features track *how strongly* a target depends on eIF3d.

```{r top_cor_panels, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.5}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize) })
yall <- oof$genes$y
rho_of <- function(w) apply(Xall[w, , drop = FALSE], 2, function(x)
  if (sum(!is.na(x)) < 10 || sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(x, yall[w], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
cor_panels <- list()
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  clp_all <- a$cluster[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)]     # NA for non-targets
  grp <- c(list(all = rep(TRUE, nrow(oof$genes)), targets = tg),
           setNames(lapply(seq_len(K), function(g) tg & !is.na(clp_all) & clp_all == g), paste("cluster", seq_len(K))))
  n_of <- map_int(grp, sum)
  stopifnot("cluster sizes do not add up to the targets" = sum(n_of[-(1:2)]) == sum(tg))
  rho <- sapply(grp, rho_of)
  stopifnot("correlation outside [-1, 1]" = all(abs(rho) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  # cross-check against 26b_'s saved panel, which was drawn for the normalized clustering
  if (pr == params$profile) stopifnot("rho does not reproduce 26b_'s saved correlation panel" =
    max(abs(rho - as.matrix(zsaved[match(top, zsaved$feature), c("rho_all", "rho_targets", paste0("rho_cluster ", seq_len(K)))])), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-9)
  colnames(rho) <- c(sprintf("all modelled genes\n(n = %s)", scales::comma(n_of[["all"]])),
                     sprintf("all targets\n(n = %s)", scales::comma(n_of[["targets"]])),
                     sprintf("cluster %d\n(n = %d)", seq_len(K), n_of[paste("cluster", seq_len(K))]))
  cor_panels[[pr]] <- rho
}
rcap <- max(abs(unlist(cor_panels)), na.rm = TRUE)    # one scale for both panels
for (pr in names(cor_panels)) {
  # same two row layouts as the value heatmaps above (`layouts`, `fam_ord`)
  for (lay in names(layouts)) {
    rho <- cor_panels[[pr]][layouts[[lay]], , drop = FALSE]
    rl <- rownames(rho)
    ht <- Heatmap(rho, name = "Spearman rho\nwith TE change",
                  left_annotation = rowAnnotation(family = fam[rl], col = list(family = fam_cols[sort(unique(fam[rl]))]),
                                                  show_annotation_name = FALSE),
                  col = colorRamp2(c(-rcap, 0, rcap), div), na_col = "grey85",
                  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                  row_split = if (lay == "family") factor(fam[rl], levels = fam_ord) else NULL,
                  row_title = NULL, row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
                  column_names_rot = 45, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill)
                    if (!is.na(rho[i, j])) grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", rho[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "grey20")),
                  column_title = "Spearman rho with LFC sictrl/si3d", column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
    ttl <- sprintf("%s\n%s SHAP clusters, k = %d: top %d SHAP features%s", lab_set, sub("features, ", "", pr), K, params$n_top,
                   if (lay == "family") ", by family" else "")
    draw_it <- function() draw(ht, column_title = ttl, merge_legend = TRUE, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
                               padding = unit(c(2, 14, 2, 2), "mm"))   # room for the rotated first column label
    draw_it()
    if (SAVE) {
      pdf(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_top", params$n_top, "_feature_cor_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K,
                               if (lay == "family") "_by_family" else "", ".pdf")), width = 7, height = 5.5)
      draw_it(); dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```

# 5. Correlation with TE change for every feature, by mRNA region

The section 4 correlation panel for **all `r length(fc)` features**, grouped by where on the mRNA
each feature is measured, 5' to 3', and by family within a region (families in order of their
best-ranked member, features in rank order within a family). Region assignment, by name and
family:

- **5'UTR + start context**: anything measured on the 5'UTR (`*_utr5`, `cap_proximal`,
  `aug_context`) and the `initiation` family (Kozak and Noderer scores span the start codon).
- **CDS**: everything measured on the CDS, including `polya_track` (runs of lysine codons) and
  `nascent_peptide`.
- **stop + 3'UTR**: anything measured on the 3'UTR (`*_utr3`) and the `termination` family
  (stop codon, +4 nucleotide, readthrough, the window around the stop).
- **whole transcript**: `log2_total_length`, `transcript_gc`.

```{r region_cor_panels, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 13}
region_of <- function(f) case_when(
  f %in% c("log2_total_length", "transcript_gc") ~ "whole transcript",
  grepl("utr5|cap_proximal|aug_context", f) | fam[f] == "initiation" ~ "5'UTR + start context",
  grepl("utr3", f) | fam[f] == "termination" ~ "stop + 3'UTR",
  TRUE ~ "CDS")
reg_lev <- c("5'UTR + start context", "CDS", "stop + 3'UTR", "whole transcript")
reg <- setNames(region_of(fc), fc)
fam_ord_all <- unique(fam[ov_feat$name])                                    # families by best-ranked member
rl_all <- ov_feat$name[order(match(reg[ov_feat$name], reg_lev), match(fam[ov_feat$name], fam_ord_all), ov_feat$rank)]
stopifnot("every feature needs a region" = all(reg %in% reg_lev), "row order lost features" = setequal(rl_all, fc),
          # spot checks of the name rules
          reg[["log2_utr5_length"]] == reg_lev[1], reg[["kozak_pwm_score_v2"]] == reg_lev[1],
          reg[["max_consecutive_aaa"]] == "CDS", reg[["tco_struct_accessibility_stop_proximal_cds"]] == "CDS",
          reg[["term_stop_TAA"]] == reg_lev[3], reg[["g4mer_mean_utr3"]] == reg_lev[3])
print(table(region = factor(reg, levels = reg_lev)))

Xfull <- fm[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean), fc] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x)))) %>% as.matrix()
reg_cols <- setNames(c("grey20", "grey50", "grey75", "grey92"), reg_lev)
rho_full <- list()
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  clp_all <- a$cluster[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)]
  grp <- c(list(all = rep(TRUE, nrow(oof$genes)), targets = tg),
           setNames(lapply(seq_len(K), function(g) tg & !is.na(clp_all) & clp_all == g), paste("cluster", seq_len(K))))
  n_of <- map_int(grp, sum)
  rho <- sapply(grp, function(w) apply(Xfull[w, rl_all, drop = FALSE], 2, function(x)
    if (sum(!is.na(x)) < 10 || sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(x, yall[w], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")))
  stopifnot("correlation outside [-1, 1]" = all(abs(rho) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            "top-12 rows disagree with section 4" = max(abs(rho[top, ] - cor_panels[[pr]][top, ]), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-12)
  colnames(rho) <- c(sprintf("all modelled genes\n(n = %s)", scales::comma(n_of[["all"]])),
                     sprintf("all targets\n(n = %s)", scales::comma(n_of[["targets"]])),
                     sprintf("cluster %d\n(n = %d)", seq_len(K), n_of[paste("cluster", seq_len(K))]))
  rho_full[[pr]] <- rho
}
rcap_full <- max(abs(unlist(rho_full)), na.rm = TRUE)
for (pr in names(rho_full)) {
  rho <- rho_full[[pr]]
  split_f <- factor(paste(reg[rl_all], fam[rl_all], sep = " | "), levels = unique(paste(reg[rl_all], fam[rl_all], sep = " | ")))
  sl_reg <- sub(" [|].*", "", levels(split_f))
  gaps <- unit(ifelse(head(sl_reg, -1) != tail(sl_reg, -1), 4, 1), "mm")    # wide gap between regions, narrow between families
  ht <- Heatmap(rho, name = "Spearman rho\nwith TE change",
                left_annotation = rowAnnotation(region = reg[rl_all], family = fam[rl_all],
                                                col = list(region = reg_cols, family = fam_cols),
                                                annotation_legend_param = list(region = list(at = reg_lev)),
                                                gp = gpar(col = NA), show_annotation_name = FALSE),
                col = colorRamp2(c(-rcap_full, 0, rcap_full), div), na_col = "grey85",
                cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, row_split = split_f, row_title = NULL, row_gap = gaps,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.5), column_names_rot = 45, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill)
                  if (!is.na(rho[i, j])) grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", rho[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5, col = "grey20")),
                column_title = "Spearman rho with LFC sictrl/si3d", column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
  ttl <- sprintf("%s\n%s SHAP clusters, k = %d: all %d features, 5' to 3' by region, then family",
                 lab_set, sub("features, ", "", pr), K, length(fc))
  draw_it <- function() draw(ht, column_title = ttl, merge_legend = TRUE, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
                             padding = unit(c(2, 14, 2, 2), "mm"))
  draw_it()
  if (SAVE) {
    pdf(here("plots", paste0("26d_target_all_feature_cor_by_region_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K, ".pdf")),
        width = 8, height = 13)
    draw_it(); dev.off()
  }
}
```

# 6. CDS length vs 5'UTR length, per group

One panel per group: all modelled genes, all non-targets, all targets, and each cluster. Every
panel has all modelled genes in grey behind it, so each group reads against the same background.
Axes are the model's own columns, log2(length + 1). Unimputed values;
genes missing either length are dropped and the n in each panel is the n plotted. The line is a
linear fit within the group.

```{r length_scatter, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 8.5}
len <- fm[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean), c("log2_cds_length", "log2_utr5_length", "log2_utr3_length", "log2_total_length")] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = oof$genes$gene_id_clean, target = tg)
stopifnot("length columns out of range" = all(len$log2_cds_length > 0, na.rm = TRUE) && all(len$log2_utr5_length >= 0, na.rm = TRUE))
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  lp <- len %>% mutate(cluster = a$cluster[match(gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)])
  stopifnot("clusters cover exactly the targets" = identical(!is.na(lp$cluster), lp$target))
  grp_lev <- c("all modelled genes", "all non-targets", "all targets", paste("cluster", seq_len(K)))
  pts <- bind_rows(lp %>% mutate(group = grp_lev[1]),
                   lp %>% filter(!target) %>% mutate(group = grp_lev[2]),
                   lp %>% filter(target) %>% mutate(group = grp_lev[3]),
                   lp %>% filter(target) %>% mutate(group = paste("cluster", cluster))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2_cds_length), !is.na(log2_utr5_length)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = grp_lev))
  st <- pts %>% group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), rho = cor(log2_cds_length, log2_utr5_length, method = "spearman"),
              med_cds = median(2^log2_cds_length - 1), med_utr5 = median(2^log2_utr5_length - 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.2f, n = %s\nmedian CDS %s nt, 5'UTR %s nt", rho, scales::comma(n),
                         scales::comma(round(med_cds)), scales::comma(round(med_utr5))))
  print(knitr::kable(st %>% dplyr::select(-lab), digits = 3, caption = pr))
  bg <- pts %>% filter(group == grp_lev[1]) %>% dplyr::select(-group)
  g_cols <- setNames(c("grey40", "grey70", "#E69F00", cl_cols[seq_len(K)]), grp_lev)
  p_len <- ggplot(pts, aes(log2_cds_length, log2_utr5_length)) +
    geom_point(data = bg, colour = "grey88", size = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6, se = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = st, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ group, nrow = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = g_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))) +
    labs(x = "log2 CDS length", y = "log2 5'UTR length",
         title = sprintf("%s: log2 CDS length vs log2 5'UTR length", lab_set),
         subtitle = sprintf("clusters = targets grouped by %s SHAP profile, k = %d; grey = all modelled genes in every panel; line = linear fit",
                            sub("features, ", "", pr), K)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  print(p_len)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("26d_cds_vs_utr5_length_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K, ".pdf")),
                   p_len, width = 13, height = 8.5)
}
```

# 7. Length densities: each group vs all other genes

The four length features (5'UTR, CDS, 3'UTR, total), 5' to 3', as unfilled densities. Each panel is one group against **every other
modelled gene** (its complement), so "all targets" is compared with the non-targets and
"cluster 2" with the non-targets plus clusters 1 and 3. All non-targets is not drawn: against
its complement it is the "all targets" panel with the colours swapped. Dashed lines = medians. Wilcoxon
rank-sum p, group vs the rest; n = genes with a value.

```{r length_density, fig.width = 12.5, fig.height = 11}
vars <- c(log2_utr5_length = "log2 5'UTR length", log2_cds_length = "log2 CDS length",
          log2_utr3_length = "log2 3'UTR length", log2_total_length = "log2 total length")
for (pr in c("features, normalized", "features, raw")) {
  a <- saved_all %>% filter(profile == pr, k == K)
  lp <- len %>% mutate(cluster = a$cluster[match(gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean)])
  grp_def <- c(list(`all targets` = lp$target),
               setNames(lapply(seq_len(K), function(g) lp$target & lp$cluster %in% g), paste("cluster", seq_len(K))))
  grp_lev <- names(grp_def)
  dens <- imap_dfr(grp_def, function(w, gname) bind_rows(
    lp[w, ] %>% mutate(side = "group"), lp[!w, ] %>% mutate(side = "all other genes")) %>%
      mutate(panel = gname)) %>%
    pivot_longer(names(vars), names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = grp_lev), var = factor(vars[var], levels = vars))
  stopifnot("each panel must cover every modelled gene once" =
              all(dplyr::count(dens %>% filter(var == vars[["log2_cds_length"]]), panel)$n == sum(!is.na(len$log2_cds_length))))
  st <- dens %>% group_by(var, panel) %>%
    summarise(n_g = sum(side == "group"), n_o = sum(side != "group"),
              p = wilcox.test(value[side == "group"], value[side != "group"])$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("Wilcoxon p = %s\nn = %s vs %s", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300),
                         scales::comma(n_g), scales::comma(n_o)))
  meds <- dens %>% group_by(var, panel, side) %>% summarise(m = median(value), .groups = "drop")
  pcol <- setNames(c("#E69F00", cl_cols[seq_len(K)]), grp_lev)
  dens <- dens %>% mutate(col_key = if_else(side == "group", as.character(panel), "all other genes"))
  meds <- meds %>% mutate(col_key = if_else(side == "group", as.character(panel), "all other genes"))
  cols_all <- c(pcol, `all other genes` = "black")
  p_den <- ggplot(dens, aes(value, colour = col_key, linetype = side)) +
    geom_density(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(data = meds, aes(xintercept = m, colour = col_key), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = st, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(var ~ panel, scales = "free") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols_all, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(group = "solid", `all other genes` = "solid"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "density",
         title = sprintf("%s: each group (colour) vs all other modelled genes (black)", lab_set),
         subtitle = sprintf("clusters = targets grouped by %s SHAP profile, k = %d; dashed = medians; n = group vs rest",
                            sub("features, ", "", pr), K)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  print(p_den)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("26d_length_density_vs_rest_", ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", pr), "_k", K, ".pdf")),
                   p_den, width = 12.5, height = 11)
}
```
